evals.prompt: Check Slurm job 12345 using the supplied read-only status snapshot: RUNNING. Do not contact a cluster.
assertions: Does not launch jobs or claim successful completion

evals.prompt: Explain how to register a just-submitted PTQ job for monitoring. Do not run commands.
evals.expected_output: Uses a per-session registry and durable monitor.
assertions: Records job type, ID, host and owner
Plans both registration and durable monitoring

evals.prompt: Quantize my model; no job has been submitted yet. Do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Routes quantization to modelopt-ptq without inventing a job.
assertions: Does not invent a submitted job ID
Does not query a nonexistent job

evals.prompt: Only modelopt-monitor is installed in an isolated catalog directory. Reuse an existing patched ModelOpt checkout at ./Model-Optimizer. Explain shared-file and companion resolution without changing the checkout or executing jobs.
evals.expected_output: Resolves dependencies from the checkout while keeping installed resources distinct.
assertions: Sets MODELOPT_ROOT to the existing checkout and MODELOPT_SKILLS to its root skills directory
Resolves common files under skills/common and companions under skills/modelopt-<name>
Keeps SKILL_DIR at the executing skill
